Train 6103 is a freight that starts at Eastmere around 14:00 and runs up towards Marlow Central, so the trains running in the opposite direction are the down-sloping trains from Marlow.

I traced 6103's line approximately, since the freight stops and slopes are hard to read exactly. It leaves Eastmere at about x≈495, stands at Wexford Rd, Brixley, Kesmere and Calder, and reaches Marlow Central at about x≈1020.

Because 6103 moves monotonically upward, a down-train crosses it exactly when it starts at Marlow to the left of 6103's top point (x<~1020) and reaches Eastmere to the right of its bottom point (x>~495).

Down-trains meeting this condition:
1. 6102 (starts ~375)
2. 1204 (~358)
3. 3702 (~258)
4. 3704 (~418)
5. 6104 (~470)
6. 1206 (~528)
7. 3706 (~578)
8. 6106 (~642)
9. 1208 (~694)
10. 3708 (~744)
11. 6108 (~806)
12. 1210 (~866)
13. 3710 (~910)
14. 6110 (~972)

Excluded: 1202 ends at Eastmere to the left of 6103's start, and 1212 starts to the right of 6103's arrival point at Marlow. The count is sensitive to the exact top point of 6103, so 1212 is the most uncertain exclusion.

FINAL ANSWER: 14
